what: While the hero video plays, a thin progress line along the bottom fills from the left by video time ÷ (length − .6s). When full, it folds back on its right end as the pivot and rewinds in .5s expo. Each time the video passes 5 seconds, the scene number goes up and the matching portrait photo in the stacked set is raised to the top. The raised photo shrinks straight from 1.5x to 1x over 5s — a workshop hero where the video scene and the side photo change together

options.scene: Length of one scene (seconds), default 5 — video time ÷ scene gives the scene number
options.tail: Seconds to bring the moment the progress line fills up ahead of the video end, default .6 — so the rewind (.5s) finishes before the video ends
options.zoom: Scale when the photo rises in, default 1.5
options.dur: Duration (s) for the photo to shrink down to 1x, same as the default scene
options.fps: Video frame count, default 24 — measure scene boundaries one frame earlier
options.--fx-rewind · --fx-ease: Progress line rewind length and curve (via style), default .5s · cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.[data-fx-part=video]: The video to measure (if none, the first video inside). Playback is up to the caller — once the loader clears, calling play() starts it from then
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Progress line fill (optional) — fills fully inside the parent line (background --kf-line)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Scene photos (optional, multiple) — stacked inside the same positioned frame. If there are fewer photos than scenes, they are reused in rotation
options.fx:scene: When the scene changes, elements { scene } Carries it along — for changing video object-position or text scene by scene

note: The original preloads the video behind the cover up to the front frames and calls play() at siteready — the part does not touch playback and only measures (with reduced motion it stops on the first scene)

from.where: index.html .tn-fv (Hero — 20-second video = 5s four scenes, four white-bordered vertical photos at bottom center, 1px progress line at the bottom)
